title: Take-Two Boss Predicts Cloud Streaming in 'Three Years', Raising GTA6 Questions
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick predicts the industry will embrace game streaming in about three years, raising post-release questions for GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO Predicts Game Streaming in 'Three Years'

In Take-Two's latest financial report, CEO Strauss Zelnick has made some bold statements regarding the future trajectory of the video games industry. As the broader industry continues to process Sony's controversial decision to halt the manufacturing of physical disc-based games and pivot toward an 'all-digital future', Zelnick has taken the discussion a step further. According to his projections, players will not only embrace digital games moving forward, but will also transition to streaming their games.

## Implications for Future Blockbusters Like GTA6

Zelnick reckons that this widespread shift toward game streaming will take place in about 'three years'. This ambitious timeline has naturally raised several post-release questions concerning major upcoming titles, most notably Grand Theft Auto 6. 

Given the monumental scale and technical demands of GTA6, an industry-wide pivot toward cloud streaming within a few years of its launch could significantly reshape how players access, experience, and continue to engage with the title long-term. As publishers rethink distribution models in the wake of digital-only pivots, the ecosystem surrounding blockbuster gaming is facing a fascinating period of evolution.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's vision highlights the industry's relentless push away from physical media. While the exact roadmap for how massive titles like GTA6 will integrate cloud streaming remains to be seen, Zelnick's comments signal that the future of game delivery is moving firmly beyond the console box.
